lockup.summary: The company, its officers, directors and all stockholders agreed not to sell shares for 180 days after the date of this prospectus, with some exceptions. After that, nearly all locked-up shares can be sold.

what: Attovia is a clinical-stage biotech company developing new antibody-based medicines for diseases caused by the immune system.
risks: It is a young company with no approved products and no completed clinical trials, so its chances of success are hard to judge.
It has lost money since it began, has no product revenue, and may never become profitable.
Even with this offering, it will need a lot more money, and may have to cut or delay its programs if it cannot raise it.
